summary_en: 1,000,000 shares to be cancelled (1.1% of shares outstanding). Effective 26 August 2026. Post-cancellation issued shares: 92,857,493. Treasury shares post-cancellation: 1,501,751 (1.6% of issued).
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: CURVES HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. (TSE Prime 7085) announced on 17 August 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to cancel 1,000,000 treasury shares of common stock under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation is scheduled for 26 August 2026. The shares to be cancelled represent approximately 1.1% of issued shares outstanding (calculated on a pre-cancellation basis of approximately 92.9 million shares). Following the cancellation, the company will have approximately 92.9 million issued shares and approximately 1.5 million treasury shares remaining, representing 1.6% of post-cancellation issued shares.
